rules.interpretation: Mirrors the construction wording: Not Acceptable when more than 50% of TIV is in buildings with yearBuilt < 1990 (INTERPRETATIONS I-2, 3.4).
Target when more than 50% of TIV is in buildings with yearBuilt >= 2010 and no more than 50% is pre-1990 (INTERPRETATIONS 3.4).
Acceptable when neither the pre-1990 nor the 2010-or-later share of TIV exceeds 50% (INTERPRETATIONS 3.4).

R-AGE-REFER: refer when any building has a known yearBuilt < 1990 (whatever its TIV) and pctTivPre1990 <= 0.5, naming rollup.pre1990BuildingIds. A flag, not a score: the factor keeps its tier and no knockout is set.

Acceptable Federato Building.construction_type values: "Joisted Masonry" (JM), "Non-Combustible", "Steel Frame" (steel), "Masonry Non-Combustible", plus "Fire Resistive" and "Modified Fire Resistive" assumed acceptable and flagged (INTERPRETATIONS I-3). Exactly 50% is Acceptable. Target column is blank, so Acceptable scores 1 (T-BLANK).
rules.fixHint: Raise the share of TIV in JM, non-combustible/steel, masonry non-combustible or fire-resistive construction to at least 50%.

rules.interpretation: "Other types" in the data are "Frame" and "Wood Frame", plus any unknown or unrecognised class on a building with known TIV. Not Acceptable iff the other share is strictly greater than 50%.

Five-year loss = paid indemnity + paid expense + reserves over claims dated within five years of the received date, both ends inclusive (INTERPRETATIONS I-4). Exactly $100,000 is not "over", so it is Acceptable; Target column is blank, so Acceptable scores 1 (T-BLANK).

interpretations.title: Primary risk state is the state with the largest TIV share
interpretations.decision: The guideline names no field and policies span up to four states, so the primary risk state is the state carrying the greatest total TIV over buildings with a known state and TIV; exact ties go to the alphabetically first code. The other states are listed with their shares.

citation.quote: The state carrying the largest share of TIV. The explanation lists the others.

interpretations.title: Building age mirrors the construction wording
interpretations.decision: Not Acceptable when more than 50% of TIV is in buildings built before 1990; REFER when any building is pre-1990 and that share is 50% or less, naming the buildings.

citation.quote: Mirror the construction factor's wording: Not Acceptable when more than 50% of TIV is pre-1990; REFER when any building is pre-1990, naming the buildings.

interpretations.title: Fire Resistive and Modified Fire Resistive count as acceptable construction
interpretations.decision: "Fire Resistive" and "Modified Fire Resistive" are better classes than those the guideline lists but are not listed, so they count toward the acceptable construction share and the assumption is flagged.

citation.quote: Treat as acceptable and flag the assumption.

interpretations.title: Loss value is five-year incurred loss
interpretations.decision: Loss value = paid indemnity + paid expense + open reserves over claims dated within five years of the submission's received date, both ends inclusive. Zero claims in the window is a known $0, not missing.

citation.quote: paid indemnity + paid expense + open reserves, dated within five years of the submission's received date
